LanguageData.DT_SoullessLetterBody: {0} has lost their soul. As a result, they will need regular injections of Determination (once every ~10 days) to survive. They have also become a psychopath. Both of these effects will be reversed if their original soul is ever recovered.
LanguageData.DT_RebellionLetterBody: The souls absorbed by {0} have rebelled. They have fled the body and left {0} gravely weakened.
LanguageData.DT_AbsorbedSoulLetterBody:
{0} has absorbed the soul of {1} and become much more powerful. This power comes with a risk however.
Under the 'Soul' tab on {0}, you can now see which absorbed souls are loyal to them. Disloyal souls increase friction while loyal ones decrease it. The amount of influence over friction a soul has comes from its determination.
High friction causes mental breaks. If it reaches 100% the souls will rebel.
